summary: Fixed BattleForce to honor the Elite keyword on bowed Followers (formula bug in src/L5R.Core/MatchEngine.cs, rules-only, no current card exercises it). Replaced CardInstance.ForceBonus (flat int, in Models.cs) with an ordered CardInstance.Modifiers list so future cards can negate one specific prior effect; PersonalityChi now sums a symmetric Chi-stat modifier. CardView (Models.cs) gained an optional Modifiers field, populated in MatchQueries.cs, so the client can render the itemized/sequenced breakdown -- both shared files, hence this lane. No client rendering added yet; see the paired lane:ui issue for that.
